$comment: Benchhood — the two schemas. (1) what each Ollama call MUST return (kept tiny to save tokens across many agents). (2) what we log per decision (the tracked parameters).

model_output.description: Forced via Ollama structured output. This is ALL the model returns — nothing else — so inference stays cheap.

symbol.description: ticker to trade, or null for HOLD

tracked_per_decision.description: What the worker records for every decision (model output + context). This is the dataset.

tracked_per_agent_report.description: Emitted at session Stop, one per agent.
